اجتذبت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَذَبْتُ (ijtaḏabtu) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذَبْتَ (ijtaḏabta) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذَبْتِ (ijtaḏabti) /id͡ʒ.ta.ðab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذَبَتْ (ijtaḏabat) /id͡ʒ.ta.ða.bat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
